item.description: Lot 3 sold for R60 000. Behind, from left, are JP Marais (auctioneer), Jan van der Walt (BKB), Melinda and Niel van Pletzen (buyers) and Johann and Elizma Sauer (sellers). In front are André Botha (BKB) and Masoyi Kotseli (handler). Photo: Gavin Isted.

item.title: SA’s poultry sector overtakes US in global competitiveness rankings
item.description: South Africa has achieved a remarkable milestone in agricultural competitiveness, with its poultry sector now outperforming the United States and ranking second globally, trailing only Brazil, according to the newly released BFAP 2025 Competitiveness Benchmark Report.

item.title: Agriculture adds 30 000 more jobs to SA’s labour force in Q4 of 2025
item.description: Despite the challenges of foot-and-mouth disease facing livestock farmers across the country, agriculture has emerged as one of South Africa’s most dynamic employment sectors.

item.title: AGOA extended: Small victory, but tough negotiations lie ahead
item.description: The AGOA trade agreement is still in effect for 1 year and South Africa is still part of it, although it does little to address the 30% tariffs on many South African exports to the US. Photo: Getty Images

item.title: It is regrettable that land reform was not mentioned as a priority area in the SONA
item.description: The Vumelana Advisory Fund, a not-for-profit organisation that supports land reform beneficiaries to put their land to productive use, has welcomed President Cyril Ramaphosa’s State of the Nation Address (SONA) delivered last Thursday, while expressing concern that land reform was not identified as a priority.

item.title: Private importer jumps through hoops to get FMD vaccine into SA
item.description: Despite administrative challenges, Dunevax, the sole agent for the Turkish company Dollvet Biotechnology’s animal health products in Southern Africa, says it remains committed to supporting the Department of Agriculture, the minister and farmers in navigating the foot-and-mouth disease (FMD) crisis. This is according to the company’s CEO, Dr David Gerber.

item.title: WATCH | Neo Brian Rasehlo explains the advantages of crossbreeding (Setswana and English)
item.description: In the video, Neo Brian Rasehlo, technical adviser at GAD Consulting Servicesand project coordinator at SerDev,explains key points in crossbreeding and why it’s crucial for modern livestock farming.

item.title: More diesel relief for farmers
item.description: From 1 April, farmers will be able to claim more under the Diesel Refund Scheme, thanks to the government’s decision to make 100% of qualifying diesel consumption eligible for the scheme going forward. Currently, farmers can reclaim 80% of their qualifying consumption.

item.title: German mission scouts Eastern Cape’s seafood export potential
item.description: A promising partnership between Germany and South Africa’s Eastern Cape is taking shape as European buyers set their sights on the province’s untapped seafood export potential. Last week, a German delegation concluded a comprehensive sourcing mission that could open new pathways for local fishing communities to access lucrative European markets.
